title: Friendly Order
statement: Badges numbered 1 to n are pinned in positions 1 to n, one per position. An arrangement is friendly when, for every position i, the badge number divides i or i divides the badge number. Return how many friendly arrangements exist.

keyPoints: Fill positions 1 to n in order
At position i, try each unused badge that divides i or is divided by i
Count when every position is filled
The divisibility check prunes most branches early
answerKey.timeComplexity: Far below n! thanks to pruning
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Generate all n! orders and test each: much slower

hints: Which badges can go in position i at all?
Only those that divide i or are divided by i. Skip the rest at once.
Fill positions in order with a used array; count complete arrangements.
